edges: Kaltouma Nadjina represented Chad in the 2004 Summer Olympics, while Moumi Sébergué was part of the delegation in the 2008 Summer Olympics.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Moumi Sébergué and Hinikissia Albertine Ndikert were part of the Chadian delegation at the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing.
Hinikissia Albertine Ndikert competed on Chad's behalf as the national delegation's only female athlete at the Beijing games.
